name: Idaho Precision Machines
old_description: Idaho Precision Machining & Fabrication, Inc. manufactures aftermarket performance accessories for Motorcycles, ATV/UTV, Snowmobile parts along with machining a wide range of food service parts. We pride ourselves on supplying quality American-made products, at an affordable price.
about:
Idaho Precision Machining & Fabrication, Inc. operates from Eagle, Idaho, where it produces aftermarket performance accessories and custom machined components. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website has been active since at least 2018 and runs under the CE Components brand (cecomponents.com) with direct-to-consumer e-commerce.

The shop focuses on custom machining for powersports and food-service applications. Its product line includes Harley-Davidson components, snowmobile parts, UTV accessories such as roof consoles, boat and fishing hardware, and a range of food-service equipment parts. The company also offers UTV service work alongside its manufacturing operations. The machining work covers both prototype and production runs, though exact capacity, facility size, and headcount are not published.

Customers span the motorcycle, ATV/UTV, snowmobile, marine, and food-service industries. The business sells directly to consumers through its online catalog — showing items such as a UTV custom roof console priced at $54.95 — and likely supplies dealers and repair shops, though specific client names are not listed.

Idaho Precision emphasizes American-made quality at an affordable price point, positioning its domestically produced parts as a value alternative in a market often supplied by overseas sources.
